SPECIFICATIONS

The Driver's Door Node is an electronic control unit integrated in the electric windows control panel in the driver's door.

OPERATION

The Driver's Door Node carries out the following functions:

  • Network key status (INT) [F040]
  • Dimmed lighting [F041]
  • Memorizing of 3 driver's seat, steering column and mirror positions [F067]
  • Timed lighting of interior handles [F074]
  • Courtesy lights management [F089]
  • Management of doors/boot and fuel flap locking/unlocking [F092]
  • Management of front electric windows [F104]
  • Management of rear electric windows [F105]
  • Inhibition from driver's seat of rear window movement [F107]
  • Electric exterior mirrors [F119]
  • Deactivation of mirror folding above 40 km/h [F121]
  • Timed management of defrosting [F126]
  • Outside temperature management [F192]
  • Management of courtesy light in exterior mirrors [F221]
  • Folding exterior mirrors [F222]
  • Electric child-proof locks [F263]
  • Electronic safety knob [F264]
  • Electric door/boot opening [F301]
  • Dead-lock engagement/release [F312]
  • Vehicle protection system signals [F322]

In addition it:

  • receives and transmits information on the B-CAN line (e.g.: diagnosis, warnings, commands, data)
  • integrates the window opening commands for the four doors, the inhibition command for the rear windows and the command to engage the child safety locks for the rear doors,
  • it connects with the driver's front door wiring.
